{{Top|leg}}
'''Master Smuggler''' was a rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]], earned after [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of service to the society. For a multitude of reasons, the Master Smuggler had retired from active [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and moved onto other areas of the business such as [[Information broker/Legends|brokering information]], contract dealers, or even minor [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] in their own right. Some Master Smugglers were known to own several [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and a stable of [[Pilot (Black Bha'lir)|Pilots]] to crew them. Twenty percent of Black Bha'lir members were Master Smugglers.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
